 Live scores and commentary 
 Melbourne Stars Women take on Perth Scorchers Women in Match 8 of the Women's Big Bash League 2026 on November 2, with both teams looking to deliver a strong performance in this exciting WBBL encounter.
 Here are the Cricket Predictions for the Women's Big Bash League 2026 - 8th Match - Melbourne Stars Women vs Perth Scorchers Women, to be played on the 2nd of November at the Junction Oval, Melbourne.
 Match Prediction - Melbourne Stars Women v Perth Scorchers Women 
 8th Match - Melbourne Stars Women vs Perth Scorchers Women (Junction Oval, Melbourne) 
Ground Stat:
Average 1st Innings Total at Junction Oval, Melbourne (Women's Big Bash League) - 146
Average 2nd Innings Total at Junction Oval, Melbourne (Women's Big Bash League) - 133 
 Points Table 
 Current Form Melbourne Stars Women:
 Melbourne Stars Women are currently placed at the 5th position on points table with 1 win and 1 loss to their credit. They have 2 points to their name. Their NRR is -0.075.
The top run scorer for Melbourne Stars Women in the Women's Big Bash League 2026 is Meg Lanning with 103 runs to her name. 
The top wicket taker for Melbourne Stars Women in the Women's Big Bash League 2026 is Annabel Sutherland with 4 scalps under her belt. 
 Melbourne Stars Women have lost their previous match against Adelaide Strikers Women by 21 runs. 
Adelaide Strikers Women batted first and they posted a huge total of 185 for 2 in 20 overs. Laura Wolvaardt was the star of the show. She smashed 70 runs in only 50 balls, collecting 9 fours. Maia Bouchier and Tahlia McGrath also contributed quite well. Bouchier made 30 while Tahlia McGrath scored 43 runs. A real boost was provided by Madeline Penna in the middle order. She smashed 36 runs in only 13 balls as Adelaide Strikers Women managed to get to a tall total of 185 in 20 overs of play.
During the chase, Rhys McKenna and Meg Lanning got their team off to a stable but very slow start. Rhys McKenna made 40 off 31 deliveries while Lanning scored 32 off 24 balls. They didn't score at a rapid pace and it didn't help their team much. Annabel Sutherland fought hard and scored 29 quick runs but she also threw it away at a wrong time. The lower order batters failed to infuse any momentum into the innings and Melbourne Stars Women were eventually restricted to 164 for 7 in 20 overs, losing the match by 21 runs.

 Current Form Perth Scorchers Women:
 Perth Scorchers Women are currently placed at the 1st position on points table with 1 win to their credit. They have 2 points to their name. Their NRR is 3.422.
The top run scorer for Perth Scorchers Women in the Women's Big Bash League 2026 is Beth Mooney with 58 runs to her name. 
The top wicket taker for Perth Scorchers Women in the Women's Big Bash League 2026 is Chloe Ainsworth with 2 scalps under her belt. 
 Perth Scorchers Women have won their previous match against Melbourne Renegades Women by 9 wickets .
Melbourne Renegades Women batted first and they posted a total of 136 for 6 in 20 overs. Hayley Matthews, Courtney Webb, Sophie Molineux and Tess Flintoff all got out without troubling the scorers much and Melbourne Renegades Women looked in all sorts of bother. Nicole Faltum and Georgia Wareham played well. Faltum made 48 runs while Wareham scored 62 runs in 39 deliveries to help Melbourne Renegades Women get to 136 in 20 overs of play.
During the chase, Katie Mack got out without troubling the scorers much. Beth Mooney and Sophie Devine then took the responsibility of taking Perth Scorchers Women over the line. Mooney made 58 off 40 balls while Devine scored 47 runs in 32 deliveries. Both stayed not out and helped Perth Scorchers Women get over the line in the 14th over itself with 9 wickets in hand.
